summary: ZJK Industrial Co., Ltd., a Cayman Islands exempted company, filed a Form 6-K disclosing an at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with Chaince Securities, LLC, dated August 3, 2026. The company may sell up to $9,800,000 of Class A ordinary shares through the agent under an existing Form F-3 shelf registration statement. The company is not obligated to sell, and the agent has no purchase commitment. The agent receives a 3.0% commission plus $0.02 per share for execution costs. This is a routine capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation.
